context.body: Worship, sacrifice, succession, and political allegiance share one public ceremony.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The assembly worships, offers sacrifices, and makes Solomon king a second time; Solomon sits on the LORD’s throne.
observations.label: Solomon is enthroned before the LORD: action

observations.body: Israel obeys Solomon, and leaders pledge allegiance.
observations.label: Solomon is enthroned before the LORD: response

observations.body: worshiped · king the second time · throne of the LORD · royal majesty

payload.posture: Read 1 Chronicles 29:20–25 as promise and succession evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Calling the throne the LORD’s does not erase Solomon’s accountability as its human occupant.
